board: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK0F (Pololu #136 / SparkFun SEN-00242) with 3-pin JST PH cable (Pololu #117, male pins)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB, footprint, LCSC). Modelled as the Vo voltage, the same way as other non-linear analog parts. The driver converts it to distance by interpolating in 1/L between the typical points in datasheet Fig. 2 and returns None outside 10-80 cm. Pin order Vo, GND, VCC comes from the datasheet connector table.
breakoutPinoutSource: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK0F datasheet p.2 'Connector signal' table (1 Vo, 2 GND, 3 Vcc); JST PH cable per https://www.pololu.com/product/136
